description: 【Powerful 350W Copper Motor & 40Nm Torque】The cordless drilling machine with 350W copper motor copper motor have a longer lifespan, suitable for long-term operations in high temperature weather.40Nm high torque can easily drill holes on walls, wood, metal, plastic and masonry. 【Precision Control: 2-Speed Transmission & 18+1 Clutch】Featuring 2-speed (0-400RPM / 0-1500RPM) and 18+1 torque settings, this drill driver ensures precise control for both screw driving and drilling tasks, making it ideal for DIY projects as well as more demanding applications. 【Flexible Shaft & LED Light】The cordless drill machine includes a flexible shaft bit extension and a built-in LED light, making working in tight, dark spaces easier. 【2*2000mAh Batteries & Safety Protection】Cordless drilling machine with 2000mAh battery provides 33% more run time than a 1500mAh batteryallowing you to drive through 800 screws on a full charge or drill through a 30mm thick wooden board for 100 times.Great Value Addition: These batteries are compatible with the Dongcheng 20V platform, offering flexibility if you plan to expand your tool collection in the future. 【What will You Get】Cordless drill machine x 1, 2.0Ah Li-ion battery x 2, charger x 1, Flexible Shaft x 1, Screwdriver Bits x 11, Drill Bits x 4, Expansion Screws x 30, Bristle Brush x 1, Sponge Brush x 1.
